features.name: Segment Posting in Dynamics SL
features.description: In Dynamics SL, vendors and transactions can be posted with designated sub account segments that control which accounts and reporting categories transactions post to. The batch control report shows the debit and credit posting accounts along with the designated sub account segments.

features.name: Segment to Dimension Migration
features.description: Segments defined in Dynamics SL automatically migrate to Business Central as dimensions using the cloud migration tool, allowing users to continue slicing and categorizing transactions when posting to the main account.

features.name: Default Dimensions on Vendor Records
features.description: Users can assign default dimensions to vendor records in Business Central. These default dimensions automatically populate on transactions for that vendor, with an optional posting value code set to mandatory to enforce dimension values exist on transactions.
caveats: Mandatory posting can be enforced but is optional based on business needs

features.name: Automatic Dimension Defaulting on Transactions
features.description: When entering purchase invoices in Business Central, dimension values that are set as defaults on vendor records automatically populate in the fact box area of the transaction without requiring manual entry.

features.name: Posting Preview
features.description: Before posting journals in Business Central, users can preview the posting to verify correct accounts are being posted to, similar to the distributions button functionality in Dynamics SL.

features.name: Trial Balance Dimension Report
features.description: The trial balance report in Business Central allows analysis of transactions by various dimensions, showing amounts posted to main accounts and enabling filtering by specific dimensions like reporting unit and company segment for detailed financial analysis.
